item.title: BD to sign trade deal with US on countervailing duties Feb 9
item.description: Commerce Secretary Mahbubur Rahman said Dhaka and Washington will sign a bilateral trade agreement on the countervailing duties imposed on Bangladesh in Washington on February 9."We have received the date- February 9. We have sent a draft of the agreement in this regard and a summary seeking approval to sign it on this date. We will be able to take a final decision later when it arrives," he said in response to a question from journalists at the Ministry of Commerce at the Secretariat on Sunday.

item.title: Gold prices fall further, Tk 251,184 per bhori
item.description: Gold prices in the local market have been reduced further. item.title: Billboards, banners torn down out of fear of public support: Nahid
item.description: Nahid Islam, candidate of the Jamaat-e-Islami-led 11-party alliance for Dhaka-11 and convener of the National Citizen Party (NCP), has said that mafia groups have been frightened by the public support.''Out of fear, they are tearing down billboards and banners one after another. A desperate attempt is underway to stop the march of the Shaplakoli.''He made these remarks in a Facebook post on Monday.

item.title: Purbachal scam: Hasina jailed for 10yrs, Tulip for 4yrs
item.description: A Dhaka court has been sentenced ousted prime minister Sheikh Hasina to 10 years' of simple imprisonment for misuse of power in securing a 10-katha government plot in Purbachal area.The court also sentenced Sheikh Rehana's three children UK MP Tulip Siddiq to four years' imprisonment and Azmina Siddiq Ruponti and Radwan Mujib Siddiq Bobby to seven years' separately.
